'''Jorille Mondevin''' is the royal historian to the court of [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]], queen of [[Kandor]].

== History ==
She is the author of the introduction of the historical narrative "[[The Strike at Shayol Ghul]]", after locating ancient documents in [[Chachin]].

Her name hints at a [[Cairhienin]] origin, but this remains unconfirmed.{{ref/book|twotc|Jorille Mondevin}}
